title: Sold exactly on the 12-month anniversary (short-term) and one day later (long-term)
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) first proviso: listed equity is short-term if held for not more than 12 months immediately preceding the date of transfer
General Clauses Act 1897 s.9: day of acquisition excluded -> bought 2024-08-01, held exactly 12 months on 2025-08-01 (not more than 12) -> short; on 2025-08-02 more than 12 -> long
Income-tax Act 1961 s.111A / s.112A as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 20 % / 12.5 % above Rs 1,25,000
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: Sale 2025-08-01: 50 @ 150.00 -> proceeds 7,500, cost 5,000, gain 2,500.00; exactly 12 months -> short 20 %.
FY 2025-26 (fy 2026): LTCG 2,500 exempt -> exemption_used 2,500.00; STCG tax 2,500 x 0.20 = 500.00; cess 20.00; total 520.00.
